article.headline: Pop Isaacs scores 17 points, Oklahoma beats Purdue 70-63 at Fort Myers Tip-Off
article.description: — Pop Isaacs made 7 of 9 from the field and finished with 17 points, five rebounds and five assists to help Oklahoma beat Purdue 70-63 on Thursday at the Fort Myers Tip-Off -- Beach Division.
article.linkText: Pop Isaacs scores 17 points, Oklahoma beats Purdue 70-63 at Fort Myers Tip-Off
article.story: FORT MYERS, Fla. -- — Pop Isaacs made 7 of 9 from the field and finished with 17 points, five rebounds and five assists to help Oklahoma beat Purdue 70-63 on Thursday at the Fort Myers Tip-Off -- Beach Division. Xzayvier Brown added 11 points and five assists for Oklahoma (5-2). Antoine West had 17 points, five rebounds and five assists for Purdue (4-4), which has lost back-to-back games following a four-game winning streak. Luke Ertel added 11 points, but went 1-for-9 from 3-point range. The Sooners scored 13 of the first 18 second-half points to make it 44-41 with 16 minutes left in the game and led the rest of the way. Five Oklahoma players scored in an 11-4 spurt that pushed the lead to nine points after Dayton Forsythe hit a 3 with 4:06 remaining. Up next Oklahoma: Hosts Syracuse on Tuesday in the SEC/ACC Men's Challenge. Purdue: Hosts Iowa on Tuesday. ------ Sign up for Top 25 poll alerts here, visit the Top 25 here and see AP’s full men’s basketball coverage here
